correctness.rationale: The minimal-generator identity holds for each finite monotone F. Coherence and bipartiteness are necessary for two genuine partition block families and sufficient because same-color blocks cannot intersect; graph coloring is bijective to ordered representations. Every connected component has at least two disjoint blocks each with size ≥2, yielding n≥4c. Four-world grids attain the bound; a three-world support triangle witnesses necessity of bipartiteness. Standalone exhaustive full-operator partition enumeration for n=1..6 agrees; computation is corroboration, not proof.
